page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or a GPU, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the ecs.sn2.large operates in the lower performance tiers. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests, such as stress-ng and Geekbench, place the instance in the bottom 25% or bottom 10% of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth is also limited, with uncached read speeds of 21.24 GB/sec and write speeds of 18.69 GB/sec. These metrics suggest that the instance experiences processing and memory throughput bottlenecks under resource-intensive workloads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2.large offers a balanced vCPU-to-RAM ratio suitable for entry-level or utility workloads where high-performance compute is not a primary requirement. Given the benchmark results, this instance is best suited for lightweight applications, basic web serving, development environments, and low-throughput database operations rather than high-performance computing, large-scale data processing, or real-time analytics.
